VTS Scoring Log

Alpha Omega Peptides

alphaomegapeptide.com · Est. 2024 · Delray Beach, FL · Scored August 2026

Alpha Omega Peptides names Freedom Diagnostics as its testing lab and uses structured lot ID formats traceable on vials and COAs. The unusual feature of this vendor's documentation model is that no COA library is hosted on the vendor's own site - COAs are instead verifiable through the Freedom Diagnostics public portal, which allows independent lot lookup by accession number. A dedicated refund and returns page at a public URL documents a 30-day window. The vendor's parent company, Melex Technologies Inc, is publicly disclosed via trademark registration and is also the parent entity of Simple Peptides. No individuals are named. Physical address (6586 W Atlantic Ave Ste #1112, Delray Beach, FL 33446) and phone number are published.

64 /100
Moderate
Freedom Diagnostics named lab, COAs verifiable via FD public portal (not hosted on own site), structured batch IDs, dedicated refund page. Parent entity Melex Technologies Inc disclosed. No named individuals, no COA library on vendor's own site.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
No community-commissioned independent test results identified in public forums as of August 2026. This field will be updated as independently sourced results are published.
Community Experience
Community feedback is limited in volume. Trustpilot includes a small number of reviews. One documented refund dispute involved a reconstitution issue where the vendor declined the refund request. No significant pattern of shipping or quality issues identified across available public sources.
Scoring Notes
COA verification exists - just not via the vendor's own site
Freedom Diagnostics COAs are publicly verifiable by accession number through Freedom's own independent archive. This is a real verification path, not a theoretical one. The gap is that a researcher visiting alphaomegapeptide.com will not find a COA database there - they need to know about the Freedom Diagnostics portal. Vendors who host their own COA libraries make that first step easier for anyone evaluating before purchase.
Melex Technologies Inc - the parent company link
Melex Technologies Inc is the registered trademark holder and parent entity of both Alpha Omega Peptides and Simple Peptides. Simple Peptides scored 24/100 (Low) in this catalog due to a fully login-gated site and no public documentation. Alpha Omega operates with more public-facing transparency than its sister brand. The shared parent entity is noted as a factual observation about corporate structure, not as a deduction from this score.
Sources: alphaomegapeptide.com (homepage, refund policy at /refund_returns/), Freedom Diagnostics public COA archive, third-party review documentation. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only. It is not a certification of product safety, purity, or efficacy.
